doc.title: Chico Hamilton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Finishing high school and gigging around LA
summary: Hamilton clarifies he went back and graduated at 19, gigged around Los Angeles after Hampton, and always dressed in a shirt and tie.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school

blocks.x: So earlier you said you went back at 19 to finish up high school. So you actually didn’t take Papa Joe’s advice, you didn’t finish high school.
I did finish high school. I graduated when I was 19 years old.
No, I took his advice until Lionel took me -­
Okay, so that’s when got you out of high school, okay.
And then what happened after Lionel fired you? You were with him for three weeks. And then what happened?
I started working around LA, I started gigging, you know. I was making all the sets and everything.
And there was no problem with your age, only being 16?
Nobody didn’t know how old I was, man.
You had your blackened mustache and you were ready.
I was ready, you dig, and I dressed -- you know, I always had a shirt and tie on, you know, stuff like that.
Did they have Stacy Adams back in those days already?
Stacy Adams, did they have Stacy Adams back then?
Oh, yeah, the Stacy Adams shoes. Yeah, I got some fedoras up there man. You think I’m kidding?
No, I don’t. I believe you.
